name: ux2-u5-segmented
prompt:
Write public/js/segmented.js (new file, about 60 lines), a classic script (STU-UX2: segmented controls instead of drop-downs). Wrap it in an IIFE.
`function segmented(select)` turns a <select> into a row of radio buttons while the select stays the source of the value (main.js keeps reading select.value and may replace its options):
- hide the select (select.hidden = true) and insert after it `<div class="segmented" role="radiogroup">` with aria-label = the text of the select's <label> (select.labels[0]), or the select's id when it has none; the label's for attribute then points at a hidden element, so also set the label's id to select.id + '-label' if it has no id and use aria-labelledby instead of aria-label on the group.
- render(): empty the group; for each option add `<button type="button" class="seg-btn" role="radio" data-value=VALUE>TEXT</button>` with aria-checked 'true' for the selected option and 'false' otherwise, and tabIndex 0 for the checked one, -1 for the rest (roving tabindex).
- choose(value, focus): set select.value, dispatch new Event('change', { bubbles: true }) on the select, render again, and when focus is true focus the newly checked button.
- click on a .seg-btn: choose(its data-value, true). keydown on the group: ArrowRight/ArrowDown pick the next option, ArrowLeft/ArrowUp the previous one, Home the first, End the last (wrap around at the ends), preventDefault for those keys only.
- a MutationObserver on the select (childList: true) calls render() when the options change; a 'change' listener on the select calls render() too.
On DOMContentLoaded run segmented() for #rating-select, #refine-rating and #video-size (skip a missing one). Output only the file.
